authenticity_review: The image exhibits high visual fidelity in the upper body regions (heads, necks, upper torsos) with sharp details and coherent lighting. However, there are noticeable artifacts in the lower regions. The legs appear to merge into the bottom frame or each other without clear joint definition (knees/hocks), and the chest area shows slight warping where front legs meet the torso. Additionally, the blue texture appears somewhat flat and uniform, lacking the micro-texture of real fur, appearing more like a generative overlay. These structural and textural anomalies prevent a perfect authenticity score.
key_defects: Lower leg anatomy ambiguity/merging at bottom frame
Flat texture mapping on blue coat lacking fur detail
